title: As U.S. Pauses Strikes, Iran Is No Rush to Resume Cease-Fire Talks
summary: Amid a reprieve in the fighting, Iran’s leaders are betting that they can endure more pain than President Trump can, and they have leverage over the Strait of Hormuz, analysts say.
